blinded_adjudication.correction: auditable reason required; aggregate outcomes never available
blinded_adjudication.packet: frozen contract, redacted synthetic logs, oracle-entailment map; no condition or aggregate
blinded_adjudication.records: independent first-failure and terminal-cause labels plus reason; detection stage and rework origin separate

ARCHITECTURAL_UNDERSTANDING_FAILURE.scenario: All synthetic facts are present, but a boundary direction is mapped backward.

CONTEXT_FAILURE.scenario: The synthetic context packet omits a required public module map present in frozen repository facts.

COORDINATION_APPROVAL_FAILURE.scenario: Two valid synthetic candidates exist, but an unresolved handoff prevents selection before the cap.

ENVIRONMENT_LIMITATION.scenario: A pinned synthetic fixture service is unavailable before either candidate can reach a gate.

FOCUSED_VALIDATION_FAILURE.scenario: A valid synthetic task-specific test rejects behavior violating its mapped contract clause.

GOVERNANCE_BOUNDARY_FAILURE.scenario: A synthetic candidate passes gates, but required approval authority is unavailable.

HARNESS_OR_ORACLE_ARTIFACT.scenario: Synthetic assertion requires an exact internal helper although the contract permits two implementations.

IMPLEMENTATION_FAILURE.scenario: A synthetic candidate returns the wrong entailed value before any gate-specific attribution applies.

INSTRUMENTATION_ARTIFACT.scenario: Synthetic logger drops an exit event and falsely extends S05; replay proves candidate and gate unchanged.

REPOSITORY_VALIDATION_FAILURE.scenario: Focused synthetic checks pass; a valid broad compatibility test detects a regression.

REVIEW_FAILURE.scenario: A synthetic review approves a visible contract violation that a valid later gate detects.

SPECIFICATION_INTENT_FAILURE.scenario: A synthetic contract simultaneously requires a field to be omitted and required.

STOPPING_CENSORED.scenario: A synthetic trace reaches the cap without acceptance or evidence selecting a causal failure.

STRUCTURAL_VALIDATION_FAILURE.scenario: Behavioral synthetic gates pass; a preregistered boundary check detects a forbidden dependency.

UNATTRIBUTABLE.scenario: A complete synthetic trace equally supports context and implementation causes after artifact checks.

limitation: This validates category reachability and procedure only; instrument-integrated adjudication awaits a frozen logger.

rehearsal_result.note: Prospective decision-table walkthrough, not classification of real outcomes.
